target.deploymentContext: Identifiers, READY/production state and disabled project protection were supplied by coordination. This receipt independently records the provider fetch responses.

method.requestType: Provider-mediated GET of explicit production URLs through the connected Vercel account.
method.access: The tool can create or reuse a temporary share link and can access protected deployments. These responses are not anonymous-access proof.
method.redirects: The tool follows same-origin redirects. Shortcut cases record final responses; individual redirect status codes were not exposed.
method.responseHandling: Parsed the returned JSON {success,status,statusText,text,headers} inside functions.exec. No full response bodies were printed.
method.equality: Decoded provider UTF-8 text was compared for exact string equality with complete exec_command cat output of the local site file. Local UTF-8 byte count was checked against a SHA-256 reference computed with Node crypto. verifiedSha256 identifies the matching uncompressed local artifact, not compressed HTTP wire bytes.
method.localReads: cat site/<explicit relative file>; max_output_tokens=500000; exact UTF-8 byte-count guard. No truncation was detected.
method.concurrency: Independent requests were issued in batches of four; no retries or alternate access paths were used.

restrictions.handling: Recorded as an access restriction; no workaround was used. Provider verification does not overturn or generalize that result.

limitations: Authenticated/provider-mediated fetch is not anonymous access from another ISP, network or browser.
No browser, UI interaction, JavaScript/Worker execution, screenshot, accessibility, FPS or cold-offline test was performed.
Headers were observed in provider responses; browser enforcement of CSP was not exercised.
Thirteen unique critical text artifacts were compared. This was not a production fetch of all 81 site files or the binary PDF.
No source, site file, configuration or deployment was modified; no old core suite was rerun.
The release remains a research beta; this verification does not establish event eligibility, official Resources qualification or learning outcomes.
